name: node-powhash
description: Native Node.js addon for proof-of-work hashing algorithms used by mining pools and backend services, including CryptoNight, RandomX, KawPow, Ethash, Ghostrider, Cuckaroo29, NexaPow, and xelis-hash v3.
author: MoneroOcean contributors

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec tests/stability.js tests/pearl_v3.js tests/pearl_v3_moe.js tests/pearl_v3_moe_one_leaf.js tests/qpow.js tests/nexapow.js tests/xelishash.js tests/scash.js
scripts.test:all: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec tests/stability.js tests/pearl_v3.js tests/pearl_v3_moe.js tests/pearl_v3_moe_one_leaf.js tests/perf.js
